facts.fact: Airtel Seychelles recently opened its Perseverance data centre and invites local and international companies to co-locate equipment there; the document is dated 2022-01-04 and gives no opening date.

The operator, Airtel Seychelles, describes its newly opened Perseverance data centre as tier-three (operator statement, no Uptime or TIA-942 certification named); the document is dated 2022-01-04 and gives no opening date.
